subject: Medisys: access artifacts & SCIM/SAML mapping handoff
messages:
From: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@medisys.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance-team@medisys.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Access artifacts request — SSO/SCIM/RBAC details needed

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — helpful context for our platform team. Our security reviewers asked for a concise handoff of IAM artifacts so we can finish the SIG assessment. Specifically we need: 

- SAML metadata (IdP/SP exchange) and a sample SAML assertion for a cleared user
- SCIM mapping export (attribute map + example delta with timestamps)
- RBAC/role matrix for the Redwood Console (roles, scopes, default entitlements)
- A short description of your least-privilege approach for customer-managed accounts

Would you be able to deliver these as either attachments or a Drive folder by EOD Jan 24? I attached the latest security questionnaire for context (medisys_security_questionnaire_v2.pdf).

If helpful, we can create a shared folder and a short walkthrough call early next week.

Thanks,
Audrey
Audrey Chen
Head of Security Operations
MediSys Health

Attachments: medisys_security_questionnaire_v2.pdf

Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Access artifacts request — SSO/SCIM/RBAC details needed

Hi Audrey,

Appreciate the clear list — we can get that to you. Quick clarifications before we assemble the package: 

1) For the SAML assertion sample, do you need a full raw XML assertion (we can provide a redacted example), or is a validated saml_response trace enough?
2) For SCIM we typically provide a mapping export plus a delta sample that excludes PII; is the delta sample acceptable if it has placeholders for email/username?

Plan: Marcus will pull the SCIM export and provisioning logs; Naomi will prepare the RBAC matrix and a short least-privilege note; Ill package the SAML artifact and provide a Drive link. Targeting an initial upload by Jan 19 and then a 30-minute sync on Jan 20 if that works for your team.

Marcus/Naomi — adding you both to kick off.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 08:26:00 -08:00
Subject: SCIM export and provisioning sample for MediSys

Hi Audrey / Kimberly,

I've exported the SCIM attribute mapping and a small delta sample (events from 2026-01-12 through 2026-01-14). The delta is redacted for PII (emails replaced with <redacted_email>) and includes timestamps and operation types. Summary of contents: 

- scim-mapping-export-20260114.json (attribute map and filter rules)
- provisioning-audit-sample-jan.log (prov events, ops: create/update/deactivate)

Notes:
- The SCIM endpoint in our hosted environment emits incremental change tokens; the attached sample includes the changeToken field and an example delta payload.
- For your auditors, the logs show service-account based SCIM calls (svc-scim@redwood.ai) and we can provide TLS cert thumbprints on request.

Attaching the files to this message for convenience. If you need the raw (non-redacted) sample we will need a data access agreement; happy to walk that through.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Platform Engineer, Provisioning
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scim-mapping-export-20260114.json, provisioning-audit-sample-jan.log
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@medisys.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 12:11:00 -08:00
Subject: RBAC matrix + least-privilege summary

Hi all,

I've uploaded the RBAC spreadsheet and a one-page least-privilege summary to the Drive folder (link above). Highlights: 

- RBAC matrix (rbac-matrix-medisys-20260116.xlsx): lists Console roles -> allowed API scopes -> default resource scoping rules.
- Short summary: customers get two base roles (Admin, Operator) and can create custom roles. Default custom role creation is restricted to Org Admins; API keys inherit a role and can be scoped to specific model routes.
- We enforce least-privilege by: ephemeral API keys (rotatable through the Console), role-based default deny, and ACLs at the route level.

If you want, I can export a CSV view of role assignments for a sample tenant — that might help your reviewers.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Product Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rbac-matrix-medisys-20260116.xlsx

Kimberly / Marcus / Naomi,

This is great — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear redaction notes. We have what we need to move the SIG to the next reviewer. A couple of small asks before we close out: 

- Can you provide the sample SAML assertion as a raw XML snippet (redacted) rather than just a trace? The auditor prefers to see the AttributeStatement and NameID format.
- Please drop a CSV export of the RBAC assignments for a sample (anonymized) tenant if it's low lift.

If you can post those two items to the Drive link by end of day Jan 21, well mark the questionnaire as 90% complete and schedule the follow-up bridge on Jan 22 to review any open questions.

Appreciate the partnership — I'll send calendar invites for the bridge if that schedule works.

Best,
